messages:
lena: starting canary rollout for release/rl-1.4 -> 10% traffic in us-west. canary id=cny-7729. will watch p95/p99 + streaming timeouts. tagging @oncall for FYI

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert triggered: canary_stream_timeout_rate > 0.8% over 5m (rule: canary_stream_timeout_rate_high). source=telemetry-service. link=https://telemetry.redwood.internal/alerts/ALRT-7729

pagerduty-bot: PD incident INC-202334 created and routed to oncall (prashant). priority=P2. summary: elevated streaming timeouts in canary (us-west).

prashant: acked INC-202334, taking ownership. starting initial triage — assigning sam to help on telemetry.

sam: looking at the dashboards now. timeouts spike coincides with the new grpc keepalive bump from rl-1.4. spike concentrated on tcp connections to grpc-proxy-host-2 (10.32.5.12). p95 latency ok, but streaming connections close at ~88-92s with deadline exceeded.

lena: ugh, we shipped a keepalive tweak in the runtime that increases idle timeout. I didn't expect it to interact with the streaming client.

anya: any customer-facing errors? Support flagged 3 customers with aborted streams, volume small but one is a high tier partner. I've DM'd support to notify them we're investigating.

martin: can we reduce canary traffic to 0 while we investigate? prefer pause rather than rollback if easy.

lena: yes. pausing canary now -> setting canary traffic to 0% for cny-7729.

ops-bot: command executed: redwood traffic update --canary cny-7729 --percent 0  
ops-bot: result: OK. canary traffic removed from load balancer in 18s.

sam: after pause, timeout rate dropped to baseline within ~2 minutes. looks like the change is isolated to the canary variant.

prashant: good. PD auto-escalation timer is 12m — I'll keep INC-202334 open until we have root cause and action (rollback / patch).

lena: my gut: revert that keepalive tweak or make gateway back-compat. I can push a hotfix but would prefer rollback to rl-1.3 for predictability.

martin: rollback sounds safer for now. can we rollback just canary to 1.3 to confirm?

lena: request rollback to rl-1.3 for canary scope. initiating rollback.

ops-bot: running: ```
redwood deploy rollback --release rl-1.4 --to rl-1.3 --scope canary --reason "streaming timeouts"
```

ops-bot: rollback started, job id rb-3345. estimated 3m. will report status.

incident-bot: note: multiple related alerts suppressed while rollback in progress. auto-escalation paused.

sam: telemetry: rb-3345 completed, canary is now rl-1.3. monitoring streaming timeouts — initial window shows no spike. p99 latency and error rate within normal bounds.

anya: support notified partner that we rolled back the canary and are validating. awaiting customer confirmation but initial contact says errors stopped.

prashant: confirming PD incident will remain open until postmortem/next steps decided. assigning to lena for follow-up and RCA (lena -> follow-up owner).

lena: noted. I'll open a short RCA doc, include failure mode, the keepalive diff, and propose either a minimal runtime patch or stricter preflight for streaming changes.

martin: small follow-ups: add canary-specific streaming integration tests and add a temporary alert suppression rule to avoid noisy pages for single-canary blips.

prashant: closing notes: INC-202334 -> status: mitigated (canary rolled back). leaving open for RCA until EOD. handback to release owner.

ops-bot: PD incident INC-202334: status changed to acknowledged -> mitigated flag set=false. awaiting manual close after RCA.

lena: thanks everyone. will file RCA and ping this thread when it's ready. :coffee:
